#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack and pretty-print XML contents of a .docx file (stdlib version)."""
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
import xml.dom.minidom

assert len(sys.argv) == 3, "Usage: python unpack_docx.py <office_file> <output_dir>"
input_file, output_dir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

output_path = Path(output_dir)
output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
zipfile.ZipFile(input_file).extractall(output_path)

xml_files = list(output_path.rglob("*.xml")) + list(output_path.rglob("*.rels"))
for xml_file in xml_files:
    content = xml_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    dom = xml.dom.minidom.parseString(content)
    xml_file.write_bytes(dom.toprettyxml(indent="  ", encoding="ascii"))
print(f"Unpacked {len(xml_files)} XML files to {output_dir}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the repacked document: well-formedness, underline placement, content integrity."""
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom
from pathlib import Path

docx_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "quarterly_report.docx"
original_path = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "quarterly_report.docx"

# 1. Check zip + XML well-formedness
with zipfile.ZipFile(docx_path) as zf:
    names = zf.namelist()
    assert "word/document.xml" in names, "document.xml missing"
    for n in names:
        if n.endswith(".xml") or n.endswith(".rels"):
            minidom.parseString(zf.read(n))
    print(f"OK: {len(names)} parts; all XML parts well-formed")

dom = minidom.parseString(zf.read("word/document.xml"))

# 2. Headlines and underline placement
paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")


def para_text(p):
    return "".join(t.firstChild.data for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t") if t.firstChild)


underlined = []
for p in paras:
    if p.getElementsByTagName("w:u"):
        underlined.append(para_text(p).strip())

print(f"OK: {len(underlined)} underlined paragraph(s):")
for u in underlined:
    print("   -", u)

expected = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]
assert underlined == expected, f"Mismatch: {underlined}"
print("OK: underline applied exactly to the 7 headlines")

# 3. Content integrity vs original (text unchanged)
orig = zipfile.ZipFile(original_path)
orig_dom = minidom.parseString(orig.read("word/document.xml"))
orig_paras = orig_dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
orig_texts = [para_text(p) for p in orig_paras]
new_texts = [para_text(p) for p in paras]
assert orig_texts == new_texts, "Document text changed unintentionally"
print(f"OK: all {len(orig_texts)} paragraphs' text identical to original")
print("VERIFICATION PASSED")
